title: Attention Is All You Need
description: The architecture that revolutionized NLP. Understand the Transformer model by implementing it from scratch component by component.

title: Kimi K3
description: A 2.8-trillion-parameter native multimodal Mixture-of-Experts model that combines Kimi Delta Attention, Attention Residuals, Stable LatentMoE, and systems designed for million-token contexts.

topics.name: KDA Recurrence
topics.description: Apply Kimi Delta Attention's channel-wise decay, erase-write state update, and gated readout.

topics.name: Gated MLA
topics.description: Build latent global attention with no positional encoding and a channel-wise output gate.

topics.name: Full AttnRes
topics.description: Retrieve a learned mixture of the embedding and every preceding layer output.

topics.name: Block AttnRes
topics.description: Retrieve from completed block summaries and the current block's partial sum.

topics.name: SiTU-GLU
topics.description: Bound both gated feed-forward branches while retaining smooth near-origin behavior.

topics.name: Quantile Balancing
topics.description: Derive next-step expert biases from router-score margin quantiles.

topics.name: Stable LatentMoE
topics.description: Combine full-width shared experts with normalized sparse experts in latent width.

topics.name: MXFP4 Experts
topics.description: Execute selected routed experts from grouped packed MXFP4 weights.

topics.name: Per-Head Muon
topics.description: Orthogonalize attention momentum independently for every head.

topics.name: Multi-Teacher OPD
topics.description: Compute clipped per-token rewards from the selected domain-and-effort teacher.

topics.name: KDA Context Parallel
topics.description: Compose recurrent segment transitions with an associative prefix operation.

title: Deep Residual Learning
description: Revolutionizing deep networks with residual connections. The foundation of modern computer vision.

topics.name: Identity Block
topics.description: Basic residual connection with no dimension change

topics.name: Convolutional Block
topics.description: Residual with 1x1 projection for dimension matching

title: Word2Vec
description: Foundational word-embedding model. Learns dense vector representations of words from raw text using two shallow architectures (Skip-gram and CBOW) trained with negative sampling and frequent-word subsampling.

topics.name: Subsampling
topics.description: Frequent-word subsampling keep-probabilities that downweight very common words during training.

topics.name: Skip-gram Pairs
topics.description: Generate (center, context) training pairs from a token sequence within a context window.

topics.name: Negative Sampling
topics.description: The unigram^0.75 noise distribution used to draw negative samples.

topics.name: SGNS Loss
topics.description: The skip-gram with negative sampling objective over a center, its positive context, and k negatives.

topics.name: CBOW Forward
topics.description: Continuous bag-of-words: average context vectors, project, and score the center word.

topics.name: SGNS Step
topics.description: One full SGD step: forward, gradients for both embedding matrices, and the parameter update.

title: DenseNet
description: Densely Connected Convolutional Networks. Each layer receives the feature maps of all preceding layers as input via channel-wise concatenation, improving gradient flow and parameter efficiency. Built from dense blocks (with bottleneck layers) joined by compressing transition layers.

topics.name: Channel Growth
topics.description: Track how channel counts grow through dense blocks and shrink through compressing transition layers.

topics.name: Composite Layer
topics.description: The H_l composite function: BatchNorm, ReLU, then a 3x3 convolution producing growth_rate feature maps.

topics.name: Bottleneck Layer
topics.description: DenseNet-B bottleneck: a 1x1 conv to 4*growth_rate channels before the 3x3 conv, reducing computation.

topics.name: Dense Block
topics.description: Dense connectivity: each layer's input is the concatenation of all preceding feature maps.

topics.name: Transition Layer
topics.description: Compress channels with a 1x1 conv (theta) and downsample with 2x2 average pooling between dense blocks.

topics.name: Full Forward
topics.description: Assemble the full DenseNet: stem conv, dense blocks with transitions, final norm, global pool, classifier.

title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
description: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers for Language Understanding.

topics.name: Segment Embeddings
topics.description: Token type IDs for sentence pairs

title: Very Deep Convolutional Networks
description: Deep networks with 3Ã3 convolutions. Showing that depth is critical for visual representations.

title: U-Net: Convolutional Networks for Biomedical Image Segmentation
description: Encoder-decoder with skip connections for precise segmentation. The foundation of modern image segmentation.

title: Auto-Encoding Variational Bayes (VAE)
description: Learn latent representations through probabilistic encoding. Generate new samples by sampling from latent space.

title: Generative Adversarial Networks (GAN)
description: Generator vs Discriminator minimax game. Learn to generate realistic data through adversarial training.

title: An Image is Worth 16x16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale
description: Apply pure Transformer architecture directly to sequences of image patches for classification. ViT demonstrates that Transformers can match or exceed CNNs when trained on sufficient data.

topics.name: Patch Embedding
topics.description: Split image into patches and project them to embeddings

topics.name: Position Embedding
topics.description: Add learnable position information to patches

topics.name: ViT Encoder Block
topics.description: Pre-LN Transformer block with GELU MLP

title: Finding Structure in Time (Vanilla RNN)
description: The foundational architecture for processing sequential data. Understand how hidden states carry information across time steps and why vanilla RNNs struggle with long-term dependencies.

title: Long Short-Term Memory
description: The architecture that solved the vanishing gradient problem in RNNs. LSTM uses gates to control information flow, enabling learning of long-term dependencies.

topics.name: Input Gate
topics.description: Decides what new information to store

title: Learning Phrase Representations using RNN Encoder-Decoder (GRU)
description: GRU simplifies LSTM with only two gates (reset and update) while achieving similar performance. Fewer parameters, faster training, and easier to understand.

topics.name: Reset Gate
topics.description: Controls how much past to forget

topics.name: Update Gate
topics.description: Controls blend of old and new

title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
description: The breakthrough paper that started the deep learning revolution. AlexNet won the 2012 ImageNet competition by a large margin, demonstrating the power of deep CNNs with ReLU, dropout, and GPU training.

topics.name: Convolutional Layers
topics.description: Large 11Ã11 and 5Ã5 kernels in early layers

topics.name: Data Augmentation
topics.description: Random crops, flips, and PCA color

title: Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models
description: The paper that revitalized diffusion models for image generation. DDPM learns to reverse a gradual noising process, generating high-quality images through iterative denoising.

topics.name: Forward Diffusion
topics.description: Gradually add Gaussian noise over T steps

topics.name: Reverse Process
topics.description: Learn to denoise step by step

topics.name: Grouped Query Attention
topics.description: Multi-query attention with shared KV heads

topics.name: KV Head Repeat
topics.description: Expand KV heads to match query heads

topics.name: Sliding Window Attention
topics.description: Local attention with fixed window size

topics.name: Global vs Local Layer Routing
topics.description: Route layers to local or global attention

topics.name: QK-Norm
topics.description: RMSNorm on Q and K before attention

topics.name: Gemma 3 Attention Block
topics.description: Full Gemma 3 attention with routing and QK-Norm

title: GPT-2
description: Decoder-only transformer with byte-level BPE, learned positional embeddings, pre-norm, and GELU activations. Build it from tokenization to generation.

topics.name: Token + Position Embedding
topics.description: Combined token and learned positional embedding

topics.name: Causal Masked Attention
topics.description: Attention with causal mask for autoregressive decoding

topics.name: GELU Activation
topics.description: Gaussian Error Linear Unit activation function

topics.name: Residual Weight Scaling
topics.description: Initialization scaling for deep residual networks

topics.name: KV Reconstruction
topics.description: Up-project compressed KV back to full size

topics.name: Multi-head Latent Attention
topics.description: Full MLA combining compression and decoupled RoPE

topics.name: Dense Prefix Layers
topics.description: First N layers use dense FFN before MoE

topics.name: Sigmoid MoE Router
topics.description: Sigmoid replaces softmax for expert routing

title: gpt-oss
description: OpenAI's first open-weight reasoning models since GPT-2. Two variants (120B and 20B) using sparse MoE with MXFP4-quantized expert weights, alternating sliding-window/full attention with learned per-head softmax sinks, GQA, and YaRN-scaled RoPE for 128K context.

topics.name: Attention Sinks
topics.description: Learned per-head scalar added inside the softmax denominator, giving each attention head an escape valve so weights no longer sum to 1.

topics.name: YaRN RoPE
topics.description: NTK-by-parts inverse frequency scaling that extends RoPE to long contexts.

topics.name: Sliding Window
topics.description: Causal mask that restricts each query to the previous W tokens, used on alternating attention layers.

topics.name: GQA Attention
topics.description: Forward pass combining grouped-query attention, optional sliding window, and learned softmax sinks.

topics.name: MXFP4 Dequant
topics.description: Microscaling FP4: dequantize 4-bit expert weights using a shared per-block FP8 scale.

topics.name: MoE Router
topics.description: Top-k expert routing with softmax taken after the top-k selection, not before.

topics.name: MoE Forward
topics.description: Sparse MoE forward: route, run clamped-SwiGLU experts, weighted-sum the outputs.

topics.name: Transformer Block
topics.description: Pre-norm GPT-OSS block: RMSNorm, GQA attention with sinks plus optional sliding window, residual, RMSNorm, sparse MoE, residual.

topics.name: Full Forward
topics.description: Embedding plus stacked GPT-OSS blocks (alternating attention pattern), final RMSNorm, lm head logits.

title: GLM-4.5
description: Open-weights MoE foundation model from Z.ai with 355B/32B-active (GLM-4.5) and 106B/12B-active (GLM-4.5-Air) variants. Distinctive: deeper-not-wider design (46 layers), QK-norm, partial RoPE, group-routed MoE with sigmoid gates, shared experts, and an MTP head for speculative decoding.

topics.name: RMSNorm
topics.description: Root Mean Square Norm: stable, no-bias normalization used pre-attention and pre-FFN throughout GLM-4.5.

topics.name: RoPE Freqs
topics.description: Base RoPE inverse-frequency table used by GLM-4.5 attention.

topics.name: Partial RoPE
topics.description: Apply RoPE only to the first rope_dim channels of each head; leave the remaining channels position-free.

topics.name: QK Norm
topics.description: Normalize the query and key with RMSNorm before the dot product to stabilize attention logits.

topics.name: GQA Attention
topics.description: Forward pass combining GQA, partial RoPE, and QK-norm before scaled dot-product attention.

topics.name: Dense SwiGLU
topics.description: SwiGLU FFN used in the dense prefix layer of GLM-4.5 (layers before the MoE blocks).

topics.name: Group Router
topics.description: Group-restricted top-k routing: sigmoid scores, pick topk_group groups first, then top-k experts within those.

topics.name: Shared Expert
topics.description: Always-on expert that processes every token, summed with the routed mixture, with a routed scaling factor.

topics.name: MoE Forward
topics.description: Sparse MoE forward combining group-routed top-k, SwiGLU experts, shared expert, and routed_scaling_factor.

topics.name: MTP Head
topics.description: Multi-Token Prediction head used in GLM-4.5 to predict additional future tokens for speculative decoding.

topics.name: Transformer Block
topics.description: Pre-norm GLM-4.5 block: RMSNorm, QK-norm attention with partial RoPE, residual, RMSNorm, dense-or-MoE FFN, residual.

topics.name: Full Forward
topics.description: Embedding plus stacked GLM-4.5 blocks (1 dense prefix layer, then MoE layers), final RMSNorm, lm_head logits.
